1//! The [DSIG](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/opentype/spec/dsig) table
2
3include!("../../generated/generated_dsig.rs");
4
5impl SignatureRecord {
6    fn compute_signature_block_len(&self) -> u32 {
7        self.signature_block.compute_len()
8    }
9}
10
11impl SignatureBlockFormat1 {
12    const HEADER_LENGTH: usize = 2 + 2 + 4;
13
14    fn compute_len(&self) -> u32 {
15        (Self::HEADER_LENGTH + self.signature.len())
16            .try_into()
17            .expect("DSIG signature block overflow")
18    }
19}
20
21#[cfg(test)]
22mod tests {
23    use font_test_data::bebuffer::BeBuffer;
24
25    use super::{Dsig, PermissionFlags, SignatureBlockFormat1, SignatureRecord};
26    use crate::dump_table;
27
28    /// An empty, dummy DSIG, as inserted by fonttools.
29    /// See <https://github.com/fonttools/fonttools/blob/ec716f11851f8d5a04e3f535b53219d97001482a/Lib/fontTools/fontBuilder.py#L823-L833>.
30    #[test]
31    fn test_empty() {
32        let empty = Dsig {
33            flags: PermissionFlags::empty(),
34            signature_records: Vec::new(),
35        };
36
37        let actual = dump_table(&empty).unwrap();
38
39        let expected = BeBuffer::new()
40            .push(0x1u32) // version
41            .push(0x0u16) // numSignatures
42            .push(0x0u16); // flags
43
44        assert_eq!(expected.data(), actual);
45    }
46
47    // A DSIG with a single entry. For ease-of-testing, we use 0xDEADBEEF
48    // instead of a full PKCS#7 packet, as it would not be this crate's
49    // responsibility to validate it anyway.
50    #[test]
51    fn test_beef() {
52        let beef = Dsig {
53            flags: PermissionFlags::CANNOT_BE_RESIGNED,
54            signature_records: vec![SignatureRecord {
55                signature_block: SignatureBlockFormat1 {
56                    signature: vec![0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF],
57                }
58                .into(),
59            }],
60        };
61
62        let actual = dump_table(&beef).unwrap();
63
64        let expected = BeBuffer::new()
65            .push(0x1_u32) // DsigHeader.version
66            .push(0x1_u16) // DsigHeader.numSignatures
67            .push(0x1_u16) // DsigHeader.flags
68            .push(0x1_u32) // SignatureRecord.format
69            .push(0xC_u32) // SignatureRecord.length
70            .push(0x14_u32) // SignatureRecord.signatureBlockOffset
71            .push(0x0_u16) // SignatureBlockFormat1.reserved1
72            .push(0x0_u16) // SignatureBlockFormat1.reserved2
73            .push(0x4_u32) // SignatureBlockFormat1.signatureLength
74            .push(0xDEADBEEF_u32); // SignatureBlockFormat1.signature
75
76        assert_eq!(expected.data(), actual);
77    }
78}
